questions.q: Which of the three 2026 host nations has won a World Cup match the most times?
questions.explanation: Mexico has the most World Cup match wins among the three hosts.

questions.q: How many times has Mexico hosted the World Cup before 2026?
What was Canada's best World Cup finish before 2026?
questions.explanation: Canada had only previously appeared in 1986 and 2022, both group-stage exits.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of points a team can earn in the group stage of a World Cup?
questions.explanation: 9 points from 3 wins in 3 group games.

questions.q: Which team is the only one to win all their group-stage matches and go on to win the World Cup since 2000?
questions.explanation: Brazil 2002 won every game on their way to the trophy.

questions.q: What is the maximum squad size allowed at the 2026 World Cup?
questions.explanation: FIFA expanded squads to 26 players from the 2022 tournament onwards.

questions.q: How many minutes are played in a standard knockout match before extra time?
Which country has appeared in the most World Cup tournaments?
questions.explanation: Brazil is the only country to appear in every World Cup.

questions.q: Who scored the fastest goal in World Cup history?
questions.explanation: Turkey's Hakan Şükür scored after 11 seconds vs South Korea in 2002.

questions.q: Which player has won the most Ballon d'Or awards?
questions.explanation: Messi has won the most Ballon d'Or trophies.
